articleTitle: Faster and Longer
abstract: Although the fiber optic backbone had been completed, R&D of semiconductor lasers became more active with the goal of longer and faster transmissions. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.55 \upmu\mathrm{m}$</tex> band had contributed significantly to longer distances, but required a new challenge, the development of single-mode laser under high-speed modulations. The DFB enabled single mode lasing, however modulation-induced chirping was still a problem for higher speed. Modulation schemes were analyzed theoretically and experimentally to reduce the chirping. This study enabled high-speed transmission up to 10 Gb/s, but also revealed a fundamental trade-off between chirping linewidth and modulation speed. This trade-off, would limit transmission length and bitrate, promoted developments of new devices, including the external feedback laser, the multi-electrode DFB laser, and the EA integrated DFB laser.

articleTitle: The First Japan Long Haul Fiber Network was Completed in 1985
abstract: It marked the beginning of a trunk line network that would replace the coaxial cable lines and microwave lines that had supported Japan's telecommunications network up to that time, and would serve as the network infrastructure that would support the upcoming digital society. With optical fiber and semiconductor lasers as new weapons supported by completely new mechanisms, great deal of efforts were devoted to the vision and verification of the reliability and economic efficiency that should be provided as a social infrastructure. We would like to look back on the systems approach toward the construction of a new era, and use it as good lessons for progress in 5G and beyond networks.

articleTitle: DFB lasers: From Research to Development, and Further
abstract: Among various single-mode lasers proposed so far, distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) lasers and distributed feedback (DFB) lasers were spotlighted as the most practical light sources for long-distance and large-capacity optical transmission. Selections of appropriated lasers were made for the applications depending on the intrinsic performances, such as DFB lasers with wavelength stability and DBR lasers with wavelength tunability. As for the applications of undersea cable systems, high reliability was required, and further devised structures were necessary to reach to a λ/4-shifted DFB laser. The unique fabrication method of λ/4-shifted grating was developed to realize quite wavelength-stable single-mode light sources which were actually installed to TPC-4 and other coherent optical systems.

articleTitle: Birth of Single-Mode Diode Laser at Minimal Loss Band
abstract: There were two possibilities, namely GaInAsP/InP or AlGaAsSb/GaSb, to create a semiconductor laser operating at possible minimal loss band of silica fiber, as suggested by Donald Keck to be around <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.4-1.7\upmu\mathrm{m}$</tex>, in 1973. There was no rigorous reason for their selection, however the former was dare chosen after pointless argument, considering its higher melting temperature. In the early 1979, the minimal loss wavelength was found to be <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.55\upmu\mathrm{m}$</tex> and occasionally, in that summer, the RT-CW operations at this targeted band were achieved by overcoming the barrier of anti-melt back. As extensions, the phase-shift distributed feedback laser was achieved its realization, and the electro-tunable laser was demonstrated, in 1983.

articleTitle: High-power single-mode multijunction VCSEL
abstract: We demonstrate a single mode 940nm VCSEL with a five-junction bipolar cascade active region. The device achieves 11 mW output power and 44 dB sidemode suppression ratio under continuous wave, room temperature operation. Peak power conversion and slope efficiency are 51% and 5.4 W/ A, respectively.

articleTitle: High-speed and wide repetition rate tuning of dual-tone optically injected mode-locked quantum-dot lasers
abstract: We demonstrate dual-tone optical injection for the control and high-speed modulation of a mode-locked laser's repetition rate. We achieve modulation rates reaching MHz frequencies and the highest continuous repetition rate tunability and ratio reported to date for a monolithic mode-locked laser (480 MHz, 2.4% respectively).

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated III/V-on-Si Injection Seeding Laser Neuron
abstract: We implement the first on-chip all-optical neuron on silicon by injection seeding a III/V-on-Si microring laser. The output of the laser at a selected wavelength resembles a sigmoid function and can be integrated as the non-linear activation function within a silicon photonic neural network.

articleTitle: Heater-tuned DBR laser diode for high thermal efficiency
abstract: Energy-efficient 16-channel operation was successfully achieved by using the EAM-integrated DBR laser diode including an optical waveguide with high thermal efficiency. Clear eye patterns were shown at 28 Gbd PAM-4 in all channels.

articleTitle: Pilot-Lightwave-based Terahertz Wave Phase Stabilization
abstract: A promising candidate for the THz wave generation technique is the photomixing of two lightwaves. Thus, a lightwave interferometric system using a pilot lightwave is invented for phase stabilization of that THz wave generation system. We experimentally demonstrate the feasibility of the phase stabilization system.

articleTitle: Si lens-coupled, room-temperature quantum cascade laser sources operating in 0.4-3 THz range
abstract: Terahertz quantum cascade laser sources based on intra-cavity nonlinear frequency mixing are currently the only electrically pumped monolithic semiconductor light source operating in THz frequency range at room temperature. We demonstrated the power enhancement of the devices in 0.4-3 THz range by using a lens-coupled Cherenkov radiation scheme. Adopting this scheme, the device produces ∼1 milli-watt peak power at a frequency of 2.38 THz at room temperature, which was increased by a factor of approximately four compared to that of a conventional Cherenkov extraction scheme.

articleTitle: Quantum Dot SiPh Hybrid Wavelength Tunable Laser Diode with 100 nm Tunable Range
abstract: We fabricated a 100 nm broadband hybrid wavelength tunable laser diode using a silicon photonics wavelength filter and a quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier (QD-SOA). Wavelength filter consists of double ring resonators using curved directional couplers.

articleTitle: 2 kW Pulse Power from Internal Wavelength Stabilized Diode Laser Bar for LiDAR Applications
abstract: We present a bipolar-cascade distributed-Bragg-reflector laser bar with an intended wavelength of 905 nm emitting 8 ns long pulses with 2 kW peak power at a current slightly above 1 kA into the third vertical mode. The spectral width of the pulses is 0.3 nm.

articleTitle: Operation of wide emitter 976 nm fiber laser pump chips with high reliability and temperature stability
abstract: We show operation at 30W of a 220 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}, 976$</tex> nm chip with beam parameter product 9.5 mm.mrad designed for application in high power fiber laser pump. Here 1200 hrs life test data at 35W is demonstrated with high polarization purity and stability over operating range. Initial prototype chips with emitter aperture up to 420 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> are shown with CW power exceeding 40W per chip.

articleTitle: Metasurfaces integrated photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers with variational emission angles
abstract: Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Laser (PCSEL) combined with metasurfaces is demonstrated to deliver various emission angle while retains the small beam divergence. The combination of the high power PCSELs and metasurfaces holds the promise of applications such as 3D sensing and Lidar.

articleTitle: 30 dBm single mode fiber-coupled semiconductor optical amplifier at 1550 nm
abstract: We demonstrate a single mode fiber-coupled packaged semiconductor optical amplifier delivering >30 dBm of continuous wave ex-fiber power at 1550 nm. This is the world's first watt-class c-band fiber-coupled semiconductor optical amplifier and may displace erbium doped fiber amplifiers in applications including optical communication and LIDAR.

articleTitle: Direct Modulation of 16-ch Two-Dimensionally Arrayed Membrane Lasers on Si
abstract: We fabricated a 16-ch membrane laser array on a Si chip with a small footprint of 1.11 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\times 2.75\text{mm}^{2}$</tex>. Optical output ports are placed on a front facet via SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> waveguides. All lasers exhibit 32-Gbit/s direct modulation with a current of 17 mA.

articleTitle: 760 nm: Jenoptik's new color for aesthetic applications
abstract: The performance of new Jenoptik 760nm laser bars for aesthetic applications is presented. We have developed and industrialized laser structure utilizing Al-free active region embedded in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Al}_{\mathrm{x}}\text{Ga}_{1-\mathrm{x}}\text{As}$</tex> wave-guiding material. We demonstrate laser operation of 760nm-bars in 1kW multicolor laser-stack as well as long-lifetime tests results.

articleTitle: Stability of spiking effect in membrane laser neurons on Si utilizing optical feedback
abstract: The stability of the ultrafast spiking effect in membrane III- V lasers on Si with optical feedback is experimentally evaluated for neuromorphic spiking neural network PICs. Stable operation, spiking thresholds, and refractory periods are obtained in two different lasers and at two different bias current regions.

articleTitle: Enhanced Beam Quality of Overlapped Angled Cavity Quantum Cascade Lasers with Integrated Notches
abstract: Angled Cavity Quantum Cascade Lasers have been demonstrated to generate enhanced brightness with power scaling of broad area laser cores while maintaining good beam quality. A further improvement of beam quality is demonstrated in overlapped angled cavity quantum cascade with the introduction of notches.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in VCSELs for Datacom and Sensing Applications
abstract: Recent advances of VCSELs using distributed Bragg reflectors (DBR) and high contrast grating (HCG) will be reviewed. Results include fiber transmission using few-mode 106 Gbps PAM4-encoded 850-nm HCGVCSELs and high-power fixed polarization HCG-VCSEL arrays for 3D sensing.

articleTitle: Synchronized two-color semiconductor mode-locked laser system for imaging and ranging applications
abstract: We demonstrate an electrically synchronized two-color all-semiconductor mode-locked laser system operating at a repetition rate of 282 MHz, generating picosecond pulses centered at 974 nm and 833 nm with peak powers exceeding 100 W and 80 W respectively and a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TEM}_{00}$</tex> mode profile at output.

articleTitle: Low Divergence Triangular Coupled VCSEL Array
abstract: A low-divergence beam with on-axis maxima can confine more power within a small spot size. The dominant supermode from a triangular VCSEL array with all three lasers in the same phase is found to provide such a narrow-divergence beam, useful for high-brightness applications.

articleTitle: Circularly-Polarized Emission from Electrically-Pumped VCSELs with Chiral-Metasurface Reflectors
abstract: We report electrically-pumped VCSELs with chiral high-contrast metasurface as the top reflectors. Stable single-mode emission with a circular polarization degree up to 57% is achieved at room temperature.

articleTitle: Electrically Pumped Quantum-Dot Lasers Grown on CMOS-Compatible 300 mm Si Wafers
abstract: We demonstrate the first electrically pumped quantum-dot (QD) lasers grown on recessed 300 mm Si wafers, with maximum CW lasing output power of 125 mW at 20 °C. This significant advance in heteroepitaxial integration of III-V gain elements onto existing CMOS-compatible Si photonic circuits is promising for photonic integrated circuit integration.

articleTitle: Infinitely scalable single-mode Berkeley Surface Emitting Laser (BerkSELs)
abstract: We report theoretically and experimentally open-Dirac cavities that exploit symmetry-dependent scaling of losses in cavities with a linear dispersion. We experimentally demonstrate that single-mode lasing from surface emitting lasers operating around the open-Dirac singularity is maintained even when the cavity is scaled up to arbitrary sizes. Our work constitutes the first scale-invariant surface emitting laser.

articleTitle: 80 GHz compact photonic microwave generation from a solitary distributed feedback laser on silicon
abstract: Microwave generation at 80 GHz is achieved from a distributed feedback laser on silicon made with a harmonic photonic potential from which a coherent beating between confined modes occurs. These results pave the way for all-optical microwave generation using compact and energy efficient semiconductor devices.

articleTitle: 128-Gb/s PAM-4 Uncooled $\boldsymbol{(25^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C}-70^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C})}$ Direct Modulation of $\boldsymbol{1.3-\mu \mathrm{m}}$ DFB BH Lasers
abstract: High relaxation oscillation frequency of 38.1 and 25.4 GHz at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$25^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$85^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> and small leak current with improved SR-LBH lasers were achieved. Clear eye openings of 128-Gb/s PAM-4 uncooled <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(25^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C}\ \text{to}\ 70^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C})$</tex> direct modulation were demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Fingertip sized external cavity quantum cascade laser based on MEMS grating
abstract: The extremely compact external cavity quantum cascade laser was realized with the MEMS grating. MEMS gratings with various resonant frequencies enabled two types of tunable and swept modes. The characteristics is shown, and we provide spectroscopy demonstration data.

articleTitle: High Temperature Operation of Membrane Photonic Integrated Circuits with Buried-Ridge-Waveguide on Si
abstract: We demonstrate a membrane photonic integrated circuit consists of membrane DFB laser and p-i-n photodiodes with buried-ridge-waveguide bonded on Si by a-Si assisted room-temperature surface-activated bonding. Over 1 mA photocurrent was detected and 25 Gbps data transmission was achieved at 25 °C.

articleTitle: Resonator Embedded Photonic Crystal Surface Emitting Lasers
abstract: Resonator embedded photonic crystal surface emitting lasers are reported. Reduced threshold current and enhanced slope efficiencies are demonstrated in InP-based 1310nm PCSELs. Band-structure analysis of 1550nm devices demonstrates that frequency selective cavity enhancement of band-edges (and hence lasing mode selection) may be obtained.

articleTitle: $1.3-\mu \mathrm{m}$ InAs Quantum Dot Lasers with P-type modulation and direct N-type co-doping
abstract: O-band quantum dot lasers with co-doping reduce threshold current density relative to the undoped case, for 1mm long uncoated lasers from 245Acm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> to 132Acm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> at 27°C and 731Acm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> to 312Acm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> at 97°C. Improvements are also significant compared to lasers employing any one doping strategy.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Self-scanning Addressable VCSEL array for Time of Flight
abstract: We demonstrated all monolithically integrated self-scanning addressable VCSEL arrays for time-of-flight. Advantages of addressable VCSELs for the ToF system are large reductions of power consumption, heat, multi-pass noise, flare noise. Detection of longer distance or lower reflectance object than that using conventional VCSEL are possible.

articleTitle: A recap of high performance AlGaInAs/InP laser development history
abstract: We review 1.3 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> AlGaInAs/InP laser development in the early 1990s for uncooled subscriber loop operations. A similar active design has been used to make 1.3- and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.55-\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> VCSELs and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.3-\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> directly modulated MQW DFB lasers for 100G Ethernet application in 2000s.

articleTitle: High Wavelength Count Laser Sources for WDM CMOS Optical Interconnects
abstract: We demonstrate a CW-WDM MSA compliant multi-wavelength source driving an error-free WDM CMOS optical link. The SuperNova™ operates up to 100°C and outputs 64 optical carriers (8 wavelengths x 8 fibers), and together with the TeraPHY™ chiplet, drives up to 2 Tbps from a CMOS die.

articleTitle: Surface-emitting Broadband THz Quantum Cascade Laser with Inverse-designed Waveguide Facets
abstract: We present a broadband planarized THz quantum cascade laser with inverse-designed waveguide facets, coupled to a broadband patch array antenna for surface emission. We measure an emission spectrum spanning 800 GHz, a peak power of 13.5 mW and a symmetric far-field pattern with a narrow beam divergence of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(21^{\circ}\ \mathrm{x}\ 20^{\circ})$</tex>.

articleTitle: Polarization Switching in VCSELs Subject to Current Modulation for Quantum Random Number Generation
abstract: We report an experimental study of the excitation of the linearly polarized modes of a gain-switched VCSEL in order to obtain random bits. The generated bit strings pass all tests in the standard test suite for random number generators provided by NIST.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Bottleneck AlGaN-based UV-B Laser Diode With a 2D Electro-optical Numerical Model
abstract: This study uses the 2D model to analyze the misalignment between the optical mode and gain distribution due to the current crowding. The reason for the high threshold current density in the reported experimental results [1], [2] is found, and a possible adjustment will be proposed.

articleTitle: Passive waveguide loss measurements in an InGaN-based laser diode structure
abstract: Waveguide loss spectrum in an InGaN laser diode (LD) has been measured and the results were compared with an InGaP LD. It is observed that the spectrum has a long tail in the InGaN LD while it shows a sharp rise in the InGaP LD.

articleTitle: Well layer thickness dependence on threshold current of SCH-MQW laser diode grown on InP/Si substrate
abstract: Well layer thickness dependence on threshold current of SCH-MQW laser diode grown on InP/Si substrate was investigated. Threshold current density was decreased by increasing well thickness, and confirmed the difference characteristics of LDs on InP substrate.

articleTitle: Characteristics of photonic crystal laser with low Q-factor suitable for high-speed operation
abstract: We investigated the linewidth and threshold characteristics of photonic crystal microcavity with a low <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex>-factor for high-speed intra-chip optical communications. We found a suitable method to measure the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex>-factor from the experiment to make it very close to the theoretical designed value.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of dispersion-tolerant single-drive mixed amplitude-frequency modulation lasers
abstract: A modulation laser generating mixed amplitude and frequency modulated signals by single-drive operation has been studied for dispersion-tolerant optical fiber transmission. 112-Gbit/s non-return-to-zero (NRZ) signal generation and 10-km transmission with the wavelength bandwidth over 40 nm are theoretically demonstrated in an O-band.

articleTitle: Generation of Various Beam Patterns based on Dually Modulated Photonic-crystal Surface-emitting Lasers
abstract: We demonstrate the emission of laser beams with arbitrarily designed patterns from single chips without using external optical elements, based on dually modulated photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers. Various beam patterns, including multiple dots, flash, letters, and even a detailed image, are successfully emitted.

articleTitle: 5-km Single-mode Fiber Data Transmission with 1060nm Single-mode Intra-cavity Surface Relief Transverse Coupled Cavity VCSELs
abstract: We demonstrate 58Gbps and 5km-long standard single-mode fiber (G652) data transmission of single-mode 1060nm VCSELs with intra-cavity surface relief. Transverse resonances provide single mode operations for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$6\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> -oxide apertures and bandwidth enhancements with reduced chirp.

articleTitle: Strong coupling, Rabi oscillations, and quantum properties of femtosecond superradiant emission from semiconductor laser heterostructures
abstract: We present the experimental results on quantum properties of superradiant emission generated by modified laser heterostructures. THz Rabi oscillations and corresponding spectral doublets with 0.8-2.8 nm separations have been observed. Nonclassical photon statistics and abnormal Wigner functions of the superradiant light have been detected

articleTitle: FMCW Measurement by the Hybrid Tunable Laser Diode
abstract: A silicon photonics hybrid wavelength tunable laser diode with a phase shifter capable of high-speed frequency modulation was fabricated. High-precision, high-repetition FMCW measurement was demonstrated using the hybrid tunable laser diode.

articleTitle: Unipolar quantum optoelectronics for free space optics in the thermal-infrared atmospheric window
abstract: Data transmission with bitrate in excess of 10 Gbit S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> has been demonstrated in the thermal atmospheric window at ∼ <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> wavelength by using unipolar devices at room temperature that have an intrinsic frequency bandwidth of few GHz.

articleTitle: Highly stacked InAs quantum dots on InP/InGaAlAs distributed Bragg reflector for VCSEL
abstract: A high-reflectivity DBR was fabricated using a highly stacked InP/InGaAlAs structure. In addition, a highly stacked QD structure using a strain compensation technique was grown on an InP/InGaAlAs DBR. More than 99 % reflectivity was obtained in 42 pairs of DBR.

articleTitle: $\boldsymbol{125^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C}}$ CW Operation of $\boldsymbol{1.2-1.3 \mu \mathrm{m}}$ Wavelength GaAs-based Lasers with Type-II (GaIn)As/Ga(AsSb)/(GaIn)As-“W”-Quantum Well
abstract: The GaAs-based Type-II (GaIn)As/Ga(AsSb)/(GaIn)As “W”-quantum-well structure has the possibility for the efficient and thermally stable operation as 1.2-1.3 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> wavelength lasers. In this work, we demonstrate <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$125^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> CW lasing operation from ridge-waveguide lasers and the reduction of a lasing wavelength shift depending on temperature which is obtained using the band configuration with the type-II “W”-quantum-well structure.

articleTitle: Gallium Nitride Diode Lasers Fueling the Fusion of Illumination, Sensing, and Communication
abstract: We present a new class of light sources based on semipolar gallium nitride laser diodes. By combining highefficiency blue laser diodes with phosphors, LaserLight white light sources offer 10–100X higher brightness than LEDs and fuse illumination with sensing and communication for the future of lighting.

articleTitle: Progress of photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers and their scalability for single-mode operation
abstract: We describe the recent progress of PCSELs and discuss their scalability, where we show that single-mode oscillation over circular areas of up to 3mm (and even 10mm) in diameter is possible by controlling not only Hermitian but also non-Hermitian optical couplings inside a photonic crystal with a double-lattice structure.

articleTitle: Self-$Q$-switched photonic-crystal lasers with band-edge frequency gradation
abstract: We propose a photonic-crystal surface-emitting laser with band-edge frequency gradation, which induces self-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex>-switching operation without saturable absorbers. We experimentally demonstrate self-pulsation with a record-high peak power of > 80 W and a short pulse width of <30 ps in a 1-mm-diameter device.

articleTitle: Advances in Long Wavelength Interband Cascade Lasers
abstract: We demonstrate significantly improved performance of InAs-based interband cascade lasers (ICLs) operating in extended wavelength regions covering <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10-13\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> with threshold current densities (J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</inf>) as low as 12 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and continuous-wave (cw) output powers greater than 40 mW/facet.

articleTitle: Magnetically switchable semiconductor microring laser with TE mode waveguide optical isolator
abstract: We report magnetically switchable operation of a semiconductor microring laser (radius of 30 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>) integrated with TE mode waveguide optical isolator. This result opens a way to the optical memory applications by using nonvolatile property of the ferromagnetic metal, and on-chip light assisted magnetic recording.

articleTitle: Interference effect in deep-ultraviolet light emitting diodes with p-AlGaN contact layers and ITO/Al electrodes
abstract: We investigated light output power (LOP) values of AlGaN-based deep ultraviolet LEDs with transparent <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p}^{+}$</tex> -AlGaN contact layers and inexpensive ITO/Al electrodes as a function of p-layer thickness. The measured LOP values were increased as the p-layer thickness was decreased. This increase was due to the interference effect. Further reduction of the internal absorption could improve the LOP of the LEDs.

articleTitle: InP-based $1.3\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ quantum dot laser
abstract: An InP based QD laser with InAs quantum dots (QDs) emitting at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.3\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> wavelength was realized. A high modal gain of 15 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> per QD layer, low internal absorption value of 11 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and high internal quantum efficiency of 82% were obtained.

articleTitle: Full-scale exfoliation of InGaN-based light-eMitting diodes via Microcavity-assisted crack propagation by using tensile-stressed Ni layers
abstract: We demonstrated microcavity-assisted crack propagation for the full-scale exfoliation of a InGaN-based light-emitting diode (LED) membrane by using nanoporous structures and tensile-stressed Ni layers. The blue LED membrane was transferred on a glass slide by using an adhesive bonding and showed good performance.

articleTitle: Quantum Optical Investigation of Metallic Nanocavity Multiple Quantum Well Nanolasers
abstract: In this work we present a microscopic theory based on a cavity QED semiconductor model to investigate the emission of InGaAsP-based metallic cavity nanolasers. The consistent approach of modelling the interplay of quantum optical and semiconductor effects allows for excellent agreement with pump-power dependant experimental results.

articleTitle: 1.39- Watt Operation of THz Quantum Cascade Laser with Highly Doped Depopulation Layers
abstract: A 1.39 W peak power and 60 mW average power THz QCL is presented by variable Al composition active structure with high doping concentration based on NEGF method design. Device has thick growth active layers and large mesa size with the AlN die bonding.

articleTitle: GaAs micro-disk lasers on membranes grown by lateral MOCVD on SOI platform
abstract: We report preliminary results of GaAs whispering gallery mode (WGM) micro-disk lasers with different diameters by lateral selective epitaxial growth on (001) silicon-on-insulator (SOI) wafers. Under pulse optical pumping at room temperature (RT), the lowest threshold was obtained at 0.7 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: VCSEL How Was it Born and Grown Since One-Century After Edison?
abstract: In this lecture we first present how the basic concept of vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser, VCSEL (pronounced as [vic-cell]) was born in 1977. It was just an inspiration after a considerable struggle to discover a laser that realizes; (i) single mode, (ii) monolithic manufacturability, and (iii) frequency reproducibility. Secondly, we focus on the physics that led to the VCSEL industry today. Thirdly, we describe their mode behaviors for their applications in communication and sensing. Lastly, we survey the VCSEL application systems from high-speed LANs in Data Communications, computer mouse, 3D face recognition in mobile phones, LiDAR in automotive and home appliance and industrial heating and so.

articleTitle: Epitaxially Regrown Quantum Dot Photonic Crystal Surface Emitting Laser
abstract: Quantum dot based epitaxially regrown photonic crystal surface-emitting lasers (PCSELs) are demonstrated at room temperature. The GaAs based devices exhibit ground-state lasing at~ 1230 nm and excited-state lasing at~ 1140 nm with threshold current densities of 0.69 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{kA}/\text{cm}^{2}$</tex> and 1.05 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{kA}/\text{cm}^{2}$</tex>, respectively.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated InP 2.5 GHz Fourier Domain Mode-Locked Laser at 1530nm
abstract: A Fourier Domain Mode Locked (FDML) laser with active mode locking has been modeled and designed. A detailed simulation study revealed that a radio frequency tuning accuracy of better then1 MHz is required to achieve FDML operation. The amplifier current and the modulation depth of the tunable intracavity filter are linked, and reveal the presence of a FDML threshold current. Initial measurements of the tunable filter performance in a realized device have been made.

articleTitle: From Coupled Cavities to Photonic ICs—It Didn't Begin With Lasers
abstract: As background, early research at Stanford ('69-'72) was on heterogeneous Surface-Acoustic-Wave (SAW) amplifiers and then at Bell Labs ('72-'80) on coupled-cavity SAW resonator filters. The laser work followed using novel Cl2-RIE on InGaAsP/InP structures to form monolithic coupled-cavity lasers ('79-'84). Beginning in 1984 at UCSB, MBE growth was developed for vertical-resonant-cavity modulators, which led to a new VCSEL structure, in which the gain was limited to E-field maxima in 1987. In 1988, the multi-element-mirror widely-tunable laser was invented. Agility Communications was formed in 1998 to commercialize the widely-tunable sampled-grating-DBR (SGDBR) and transponders. Agility was acquired by JDSU in 2005, and Lumentum was spun out a few years later. Photonic ICs that add detectors, amplifiers, modulators, and other components were researched at UCSB as well as these companies and such PICs were contained in most products. Millions of SGDBRs are now operating in the field carrying live traffic.

articleTitle: Progress in efforts to increase power in GaAs-based highpower diode lasers
abstract: Research into power-scaling in GaAs-based broad-area lasers is summarized, focusing on 940nm single emitters, increasing power by combining triply-asymmetric high-gain epitaxial designs with regrown lateral blocking. In parallel, power is increased by transitioning more laser types to highly asymmetric designs, illustrated with 970nm grating-stabilized bars.

articleTitle: High power 1.55 $\boldsymbol{\mu\mathrm{m}}$ DFB laser with GHz modulation capability for low-orbit optical communication system
abstract: In this work, we develop and present a 1.55 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> DFB laser that demonstrates ultra-high optical power, excellent wavelength stability, high SMSR, narrow linewidth, and high-speed modulation capabilities. These features make it suitable for coherent light sources used in low-orbit satellite optical communications.

articleTitle: Hybrid modeling technique for on-chip extended cavity semiconductor mode-locked lasers
abstract: This work presents a hybrid modeling technique to simulate extended cavity semiconductor mode-locked lasers, using a combination of traveling wave equations with the nonlinear Schrödinger equation. The simulations are compared to and show correspondence with experimental results from a III-V-on-silicon mode-locked laser.

articleTitle: Beam-curvature-compensation of Solid-state VCSEL Beam Scanner using Curved Prism Mirror
abstract: We demonstrate the beam-curvature-compensation of a solid-state VCSEL beam scanner by using a newly designed curved prism mirror. The curvature of the fan beam could be reduced by a factor of 20 so that a straight line beam is realized for 1D-scanning ToF LiDARs.

articleTitle: $\boldsymbol{\sim 8.5\mu \mathrm{m}}$ InP-based quantum cascade lasers grown on GaAs by MOCVD
abstract: InP-based quantum cascade lasers on (001) GaAs with watt-level output power and low pulsed threshold-current density at RT. A 35-stage <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\ln 0.53\text{GaAs}/\text{In}0.52\text{AlAs}$</tex> lattice-matched active-region QCL is grown by MOCVD, on an InP metamorphic buffer with strained InAs or InGaAs quantum wells as dislocation filters.

articleTitle: Temperature Characteristics of Self-scanning Addressable VCSEL array for Time of Flight
abstract: We demonstrated temperature characteristics of self-scanning addressable VCSEL (SS- VCSEL) array for time of flight. Lasing of SS- VCSEL was achieved up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$70^{\circ}$</tex> and temperature characteristics of Far Field Pattern (FFP) for SS- VCSEL is 18 deg@1/e/2,RT(-0.03 deg/K) and beam shapes is unimodal regardless of temperatures.

articleTitle: GaSb-based angled cavity semiconductor lasers
abstract: Angled cavities can suppress filamentation in mid-IR broad area diode lasers we fabricated, but some high order modes still exist. By removing certain regions that don't contribute gain to the fundamental mode, we demonstrate improved beam quality, and a ~2 fold brightness enhancement.

articleTitle: Expanding Field of View of Solid-state VCSEL Beam Scanner with Multi-wavelength Seed VCSELs
abstract: We demonstrate solid-state VCSEL beam scanners integrated with multi-grating pitch tunable seed VCSELs for expanding FOV and scanning resolutions. The total FOV of over <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$12^{\circ}$</tex> and the corresponding resolution points of 166, which could be double in comparison with a single VCSEL beam scanner.

articleTitle: On the Mode and Wavelength Stability of Ultra-high-speed Directly-modulated Passive Feedback DFB Lasers
abstract: We examined the mode and wavelength stability of DFB lasers with passive waveguide reflector (PFL) that was demonstrated for transmitting >400-Gb/s signals. The PFL can maintain high single-mode yield of 87.87% but shows potential 6.9-nm wavelength drift for varying the front and rear facet phases.

articleTitle: Operation characteristics on short pulse below 100 ps based on transverse mode control with free carrier effect in an oxide-confined VCSEL
abstract: a single short pulse laser output below 100 ps is demonstrated with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Gamma$</tex> -switch VCSEL. Short pulse is realized by controlling the transverse mode distribution by free carrier plasma effect in oxide confined VCSEL. Pulse train is also demonstrated with tuning electric amplitude.

articleTitle: Wide Wavelength Range Emission from InAs/GaSb Type-II Superlattice Grown by MOVPE
abstract: We investigated the emission wavelength shift of type-II InAs/ GaSb superlattice on InAs substrate grown by MOVPE. With increasing the injection carrier density, very wide wavelength range emission over 2000 nm was observed. Calculated spectrum using <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k\cdot p$</tex> perturbation method show the same tendency.

articleTitle: Low threshold current operation of membrane DR laser on Si with buried-ridge waveguide and ACPM grating for On-chip Optical Interconnection
abstract: To reduce energy consumption of GaInAsP membrane laser on Si, we introduced BRW (buried-ridge-waveguide) structure and ACPM (Asymmetric Corrugation Pitch Modulation) grating to enhance the optical confinement to active region. Low threshold current of 0.16 mA and SMSR of 45dB were obtained by fabricating membrane DR laser with these structures.

articleTitle: Hydrogen cleaning for high-quality conductive AlInN/GaN DBRs
abstract: We introduced hydrogen cleaning to a fabrication of n-type conductive AlInN/GaN DBRs to achieve both high conductivity and high material quality, resulting in a 40-pair conductive AlInN/GaN DBR with a low vertical resistance and a much lower surface pit density attributed to threading dislocations.

articleTitle: Monolithic tunable lasers for digital coherent communications
abstract: Narrow linewidth tunable lasers have been developed as the digital coherent systems have been used in optical networks. In this paper, stable DFB laser array types and compact DBR/Ring laser, which have been developed recently, will be reported.

articleTitle: Integrated-photonic device serving as both external laser mirror and input grating coupler
abstract: A guided-mode-resonance device was designed and fabricated for wavelength-selective retroreflection and waveguide input coupling. This device consists of two kinds of waveguide gratings on a high-reflection substrate. Wavelength-stabilized laser oscillation with a gain chip and simultaneous input coupling to a waveguide were demonstrated successfully.

articleTitle: III-V Quantum Dot Lasers on Silicon by Selective Area Heteroepitaxy
abstract: We present our recent progress on III-V lasers selectively grown on flat-bottom and nano V-groove patterned silicon substrates inside silicon dioxide recesses. This selective area heteroepitaxy (SAH) approach is disruptive for monolithic integration of III-V photonic devices on silicon photonic and microelectronic platforms.

articleTitle: Coherent Antiguided High Contrast Grating VCSEL Array
abstract: We demonstrate coherent VCSEL arrays using a novel antiguided high contrast grating (HCG) structure that consists of two distinct HCG dimensions in one monolithic layer. Narrow single-lobed fundamental and double-lobed highest-order array mode emission are achieved with in- and out-of- phase coupling sections, respectively.

articleTitle: Testing a generalized Siegert relation for characterizing semiconductor nanolaser emission
abstract: We present a quantum-optical model to check the validity of the Siegert relation in the partially coherent emission regime of semiconductor nanolaser as commonly used in nanolaser characterizations. We discuss different device regimes and quantify the influence of inter-emitter correlations in our quantum-optical laser theory.

articleTitle: GaSb/Si3N4 Widely Tunable Hybrid Vernier Laser Emitting Around $2.55\ \mu\mathrm{m}$
abstract: We demonstrate a GaSb/Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> Vernier hybrid laser with a wide tuning range of 170 nm around <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.55\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, exhibiting > 1 mW of output power in continuous wave over the entire band, making such laser very attractive for sensing applications.

articleTitle: High Power 14xx-nm Raman Pump Using GaInAsP/InP Electric-Field-Control Layers
abstract: 14xx-nm Raman-pump of 1-Watt was demonstrated in a 14pin-butterfly package by using an 5mm-laser cavity with a low optical confinement having an electric-field-controle-layer consisted of GaInAsP/InP multilayer structure. The power consumption of 11.3W at 800mW of fiber output power was obtained at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$35^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C}$</tex> LD-chip temperature.

articleTitle: High-brightness broad-area diode lasers with a novel enhanced self-aligned lateral structure
abstract: We present broad-area lasers with enhanced self-aligned lateral structure (eSAS) using current-blocking layers optimized for tunnel current suppression, integrated within the p-AlGaAs cladding using in-situ etching and epitaxial regrowth. Lateral leakage is tenfold reduced, for 30% lower threshold, higher peak efficiency, and improved beam parameters.

articleTitle: Reduced Temperature-Dependence of Optical Gain in Type-II GaAs-based “W”-Laser Structures
abstract: We investigate the temperature-dependence of modal gain for type-II (GaIn)As/Ga(AsSb) “W”-laser structures operating around the O-band. Measurements show their potential to control the temperature dependence of the gain due to carrier-induced band bending effects. This is of interest to semiconductor laser and optical amplifier applications.

articleTitle: Power Scaling of InP based Photonic Crystal Surface Emitting Lasers for CWDM Optical Interconnects in Hyperscale Datacenters
abstract: We demonstrate power scaling of InP substrate emitting PCSELs by increasing device size. A maximum power of 713mW was obtained. We attribute improved slope efficiency of larger devices to reduced in-plane loss. These devices are suitable for integration into hybrid, co-packaged optical transceivers in datacenters.

articleTitle: GaSb/Si laser spectrometer-on-chip technology for sensing applications
abstract: Hybrid GaSb/Si tunable laser spectrometer-on-a-chip technology offers scalable all-semiconductor solutions for spectroscopic sensing of liquids and multiple gases in 1900 nm- 2400 nm the spectral range. We demonstrate a 4-channel spectrometer on chip with> 400 nm tuning bandwidth and excellent power and wavelength stability.

articleTitle: Multi-mode Interference Reflector based InAs-QD Laser
abstract: InAs quantum dot multi-mode-interference-reflector (MMIR) lasers, based on a 1-port MMIR and a single cleaved reflector, are designed, fabricated, and characterized to demonstrate capability for optoelectronic-integrated-circuits. Threshold current densities are less than 40% of those in cleaved-cleaved ridge waveguide lasers of the same cavity length.

articleTitle: Spectral Linewidth of Photonic Crystal Surface Emitting Lasers
abstract: The spectral linewidth of photonic crystal surface emitting lasers is evaluated using a heterodyne method utilizing two nominally identical devices. Linewidths of 100–200 kHz are obtained at modest output powers for these GaAs based 935 nm PCSELs. The natural linewidth is determined to be <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$71\pm 30 \ \text{kHz}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Room-temperature optical gain in terahertz quantum cascade lasers based on GaAs/AlGaAs, GaN/AlGaN, ZnO/ZnMgO
abstract: The optical gain mappings are predicted for terahertz quantum cascade lasers by using different material systems, i.e., small LO-phonon energy GaAs/AlGaAs, large LO-phonon energy GaN/AlGaN, ZnO/ZnMgO quantum wells. With specific design to avoid the corresponding shortcomings in those different materials, the room-temperature operations are feasible.

articleTitle: Temperature-insensitive InP-based Quantum Well Lasers Operating in the O-band for Datacom Applications
abstract: We describe the use of a modified QW structure to achieve temperature stability in O-band lasers. We show the potential for temperature insensitivity of threshold from -40 to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$+80{\ }^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> in an InGaAsP/InP structure. Such devices are of interest for lower energy consuming datacomms systems.

articleTitle: Stability Evaluation of Quantum-Dot External-Cavity Multi-Wavelength Laser for Grid-Free WDM System
abstract: We have evaluated the stability of a multi-wavelength laser. The use of QD-SOA and ring-based external cavity enabled 8-wavelength simultaneous drifting with stable wavelength spacing at 378.1 GHz, which is suitable for uncooled light-source for the wavelength grid-free WDM system.

articleTitle: Non-mechanical 3D LiDAR system based on flash and beam-scanning dually-modulated photonic-crystal lasers
abstract: We report a new type of non-mechanical three-dimensional (3D) light detection and ranging (LiDAR) system, which integrates a beam-scanning-type and flash-type dually modulated photonic-crystal laser sources, having a size as small as the palm of the hand. The system is capable of measuring poorly reflective objects in the field of view, overcoming the intrinsic issue affecting conventional flash-type LiDAR systems.

articleTitle: Telecom micro-lasers grown on SOI by lateral epitaxy
abstract: We report telecom micro-ring lasers selectively grown on industry-standard (001)-oriented silicon-on-insulator wafers using lateral aspect ratio trapping. Laser structures with InP claddings and lateral QW active region were grown. Micro-ring lasers with various dimensions feature a co-planar configuration with the Si device layer. Room temperature pulsed lasing with a low threshold of 20 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{J}/\text{cm}^{2}$</tex> was obtained.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation of High-Speed Surface-Normal Modulator Using InP High-Contrast Grating
abstract: We propose a surface-normal optical modulator using an InP high-contrast grating embedded with electro-optic polymer. The feasibility of broad-bandwidth (>40 GHz) and low-loss (<0.22 dB) modulation is numerically demonstrated, thanks to the high electron mobility and the small optical absorption of n- InP.

articleTitle: High-power, high-brightness shortwave infrared lasers
abstract: High-power spatially single-mode diode lasers at 15xx nm wavelengths are of interest for Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) at eye-safe wavelengths, as pump lasers for Raman and rare-earth doped fiber amplifiers as well as for material processing. A cost-efficient way to realize high-power in combination with high brightness is the tapered resonator concept. We have grown by MOCVD InGaAsP/InP based diode lasers and tapered amplifiers with fast axis far fields of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$36^{\circ}$</tex> FWHM and wavelengths around 1550 nm. CW output power of more than 3.7W for tapered lasers and 2.3W for tapered amplifiers in MOPA configuration have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Laser characteristics of Circular Defect in 2D photonic crystal (CirD) laser with semicircular output port
abstract: We fabricate CirD lasers with a semicircular output port attached to the end of the waveguide and evaluate them by optical pumping. We have experimentally confirmed that the spread of the output light is suppressed when the output port is present.

articleTitle: High order vortex beams generated directly from photonic-crystal surface-emitting laser with honeycomb lattice
abstract: We demonstrate that high order vortex beams are generated directly from honeycomb-lattice photonic crystal surface-emitting laser. The measured divergence angle is about 1 degree, and the far field pattern was proved to be superposition of RCP and LCP with topological charge ±2, respectively.

articleTitle: Polarization-Stable VCSEL-Arrays
abstract: We present our 940nm VCSEL-arrays with linearly polarization emission. To achieve high output powers, arrays with multiple emitters and transversal multi-mode chips are analyzed. All VCSEL-arrays feature the novel surface grating technology based on SCIL-nanoimprint, capable for precise and high-volume fabrication.

articleTitle: Band structure engineering and its impact on semiconductor laser design and optimisation
abstract: Ideal semiconductor lasers exploit very simple and clever physics. We first review how strain and well deigned carrier and optical confinement can give very impressive performance and then address some of the intrinsic and extrinsic challenges to efficient emission across a wide spectral range.

articleTitle: Low-thermal-resistance by Decoupled Ridge Insulation Structure for hybrid GaInAsP/SOI ridge-waveguide lasers
abstract: Low-thermal-resistance hybrid GaInAsP/SOI ridge-waveguide Fabry-Perot lasers were demonstrated. Novel ridge-insulation structure was introduced to enhance heat dissipation. Record low thermal resistance of 14.3 K/W were demonstrated at 2-mm-cavity length even on SOI with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.0-\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>-thick oxide layer.

articleTitle: RF-Injection Control of Quantum Cascade Lasers in the Time-Domain
abstract: In this work, we demonstrate control over the time-domain state quantum cascade laser output state using microwave modulation. We demonstrate narrow, pulse-like features with a full-with at half-maximum of 558 fs when isolated, which corresponds to the expected Fourier-transform limited pulse-width.

articleTitle: High-Power Single-Mode Operation of $\boldsymbol{1.3 \mu \mathrm{m}}$ Wavelength Double-Lattice Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers using InP-based Regrowth Process
abstract: We demonstrate high-power and single-mode lasing of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.3-\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> -wavelength InP-based photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers. An output power of over 250mW at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$25^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C}$</tex> and that of over 150mW at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C}$</tex> under continuous-wave conditions are achieved. Single-mode lasing with a high side-mode suppression ratio of over 60dB is obtained.

articleTitle: Longitudinal mode control in $20-30\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ long cavity GaN-based VCSELs with a curved mirror
abstract: A single cavity filtering mirror was used to demonstrate single longitudinal mode operation for a VCSEL with a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 25\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> cavity length. The 443.5 nm lasing peak had an SMSR of 42 dB at 9 mA, 70kA/cm2.

articleTitle: Lineshape Anomaly in Lasers Operating Close to Fundamental Limit: Theory and Experiment
abstract: We describe investigations on quantum fluctuations in semiconductor lasers relating to a lineshape anomaly while lasing at the spontaneous-emission limit. Measurements show an emerging Gaussian component, contradicting the cavity-QED predicted Lorentzian lineshape. Theoretical studies indicate an intrinsic contribution from intricate cavity-outcoupling and active-medium nonlinearity interplay.

articleTitle: Semiconductor nanolasers
abstract: We describe recent progress on semiconductor nanolasers. Electrically-injected photonic crystal lasers achieve ultralow-threshold current. New cavity designs enable the localization of photons below the diffraction limit, with prospects for squeezing of intensity noise. Finally, by exploiting a Fano resonance, narrow-linewidth operation can be achieved.

articleTitle: Beam Properties of High-Power Reliable Mid-IR Quantum Cascade Lasers after 1300 Hours of Aging
abstract: Quantum cascade lasers emitting in the mid-infrared have demonstrated extremely stable and reliable single-spatialmode operation. For the first time, we present the beam quality data of devices before and after 1300 hours of aging at high optical-power densities as well as high current densities.

articleTitle: Bullseye antenna-coupled THz ring quantum cascade laser for frequency comb operation
abstract: We report comb operation of RF injected ring Quantum Cascade Lasers. A coupled waveguide approach is implemented for dispersion compensation while a passive bullseye antenna improves the device power extraction and far-field pattern. Phase sensitive measurements are presented which hint at the presence of a soliton state.

articleTitle: Waterproof perovskite quantum dot laser
abstract: In this study, CsPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> perovskite was encapsulated with a metal-organic framework (UiO-66) to improve its durability for up to 12 months. We distribute the fabricated quantum dots in an optical resonant cavity formed by two DBR mirrors. Studies have shown that the fabricated samples can be directly immersed in water to achieve laser light emission at room temperature.

articleTitle: Advances in Quantum Dot Lasers - 40 Years of History
abstract: A 40-year history of quantum dots that enable high-performance semiconductor lasers is reviewed. The discussion includes the early days of quantum dot laser research, the demonstration of high-temperature operation, applications in silicon photonics, and recent advances in quantum dot light sources.

articleTitle: Towards Continuous Wave, Single Mode, Surface-Emitting Lasers at $24\mu\mathrm{m}$ and $28\mu\mathrm{m}$
abstract: A surface emitting, single mode laser at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$24\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> is presented, based on InGaAs/AlInAs system, processed into a metal-metal device and employing planarization technology. Lasing at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$28\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> can also be achieved by using heat extraction techniques that improve dissipation on the way to continuous wave operation.

articleTitle: Semi-cooled 128-Gbit/s NRZ operation of directly modulated membrane lasers on SiC substrate
abstract: We report membrane lasers on high-thermal-conductivity SiC exhibiting flat small-signal responses with 3-dB bandwidths of 98 and 84 GHz at 25 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$55^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>, respectively, due to the high relaxation oscillation frequency and photon-photon resonance frequency. The laser is capable of semi-cooled 128-Gbit/s NRZ transmission.

articleTitle: 56 GBd high power InP EAM chip for hybrid integration
abstract: We demonstrate an InP EAM chip with high (> 5 mW) fibre-coupled output power, large (> 35 GHz) bandwidth, and wide (>15 nm) wavelength range. The BH device includes integrated amplifiers with spot size converters at in- and output supporting hybrid integration with e.g. tunable lasers or PICs.

articleTitle: High-temperature Operation of Membrane DR Lasers Integrated with Si Waveguide by Micro-transfer Printing Method
abstract: We fabricate a membrane distributed-reflector lasers with a Si waveguide by using micro-transfer printing, achieving a low threshold current of 1.1-3.7 mA in a temperature range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$25-80^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> and good optical coupling between the laser output and 220-nm-thick Si waveguides.

articleTitle: In-situ reflectivity spectra measurements of GaN-Based VCSELs
abstract: We measured in-situ reflectivity intensity at a resonance wavelength as a function of a GaN cavity length on an AlINN/GaN DBR. The reflectivity intensity oscillation at the resonance wavelength was observed, suggesting that an accurate cavity length control is possible.

articleTitle: High Power, Optical Feedback- Tolerant 1310 nm Quantum Dot DFB Lasers
abstract: We have developed 1310 nm high power quantum dot distributed feedback lasers. Optical output power of >40 m W at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$85^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> was achieved with sidemode suppression ratio of >50 dB. Stable relative intensity noise against external optical feedback was observed under high power operation.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave Operation of GaSb-based Interband Cascade Lasers beyond $\boldsymbol{6\mu \mathrm{m}}$
abstract: GaSb-based Fabry-Pérot interband cascade lasers with a center emission wavelength of 6.12 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, showing the lowest reported threshold current density of 612 A/cm2 at this wavelength at room temperature are presented. An epi-side-down mounted device showed over 25 mW cw-output power at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$20^{\mathrm{o}}\mathrm{C}$</tex>.

articleTitle: InP/GaAsP DWELL lasers grown on (001) Si emitting at 740 nm
abstract: We report electrically pumped InP/GaAsP dot-in-well (DWELL) lasers grown on (001) Si. The lowest threshold current density of the DWELL laser on Si is 1.67 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, measured on a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> device. The maximum operating temperature is 40 °C.

articleTitle: Influence of External Cavity Configuration on the Failure Mode of High Power Wavelength Stabilized Laser Diode
abstract: Failure mode of high power laser diode under wavelength stabilized operation is investigated. Differences in the external cavity layout is found to affect near-field pattern inhomogeneity which is induced by optical feedback, resulting in a significant impact on the ratio of facet failure.

articleTitle: Tunable lasers from research to volume production — a personal view
abstract: This talk is a personal account of the author's experience from R&D on tunable lasers and the efforts of getting the lasers out of the research lab and into commercial volume production. The story begins with early research in Sweden and a very formative year as a guest researcher in Japan. After specialising in tunable lasers there were many efforts to get industry interested. Eventually the first tunable laser start-up company Altitun was founded in 1996. The main product was the widely tunable GCSR laser with related wavelength control that allowed access to any wavelength channel within the 40nm wide C-band. Rapid growth followed, and after being bought by a major industrial company, Altitun was closed down in the IT crash of 2002. A second start-up company, Syntune, was built on the remains of the first. Syntune brought to market widely tunable transmitters and transceivers based on photonic integrated circuits by combining the novel MGY widely tunable laser design with modulators, amplifiers and other components, all monolithically integrated on a single InP chip. This company has changed owners and name several times and after a spectacular series of ups and downs it is now a major supplier of tunable lasers, tunable transceiver modules and related photonics components. All chip production is still done in the same Swedish fab, albeit a lot expanded, as the first company Altitun.

articleTitle: Design of a Quantum-Dot Single-Photon Source on a Silicon Nitride Waveguide for Efficient Photon Generation by Resonant Excitation
abstract: We design a quantum-dot single-photon source with a defect-based photonic crystal cavity on a SiN waveguide that subdues crosstalk from resonant excitation and has >90% coupling efficiency. It is expected to efficiently generate single photons with high purity and indistinguishability for scalable integrated quantum photonics.

articleTitle: Monolithic DBR/Ring Tunable Laser Employing $\boldsymbol{1\times 2}$ MMI-coupled Ring Resonator
abstract: A wavelength tunable DBR/Ring laser employing a novel <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\times 2$</tex> MMI -coupled ring resonator has been developed to obtain robust fabrication tolerance. The fabricated laser can operate in extended C-band with output power of 18 dBm, SMSR of 40 dB, and tuning range of 54 nm.

articleTitle: Low Threshold $1.55\ \mu\mathrm{m}$-Band Quantum Dot Laser Diode with InP(311)B Substrate
abstract: We successfully improved characteristics of ridge structured QD-LD and demonstrated threshold current of 9.5 mA and corresponding threshold current density of 0.34 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, whose value was the lowest class previously reported as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.55 \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex>-band edge emitted type QD-LDs to the best of our knowledge.

articleTitle: 0.57% EQE and 4.2 mW Power of 232 nm AlGaN Far-DVC LED with Modulation Mg doped p-interlayer and Polarization Doped Transparent p-Contact Layer
abstract: In order to improve injection efficiency, we introduced the modulation Mg doped p-interlayer and the slightly graded polarization doped p-AlGaN layer into AlGaN far-UV LEDs. As results of, we obtained 0.57% EQE and 4.2mW power operation of 232 nm LED with polarization-doped transparent p-contact layer.

articleTitle: Mode selection and switching in ring quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Travelling waves are a signature of ideal ring resonators; however, in practice they are only realized under unidirectional operation of the resonator. We demonstrate a novel method for controllable mode selection and switching between the two counterpropagating modes of a ring quantum cascade laser.
